slices.title: Guest quiz quota
slices.intent: Delivers the quiz_grade_quota table in the ensure chain, the flag-gated quota consumer, and the quiz-grade route stacking quota over the existing guard.

symbols.name: ensureAuthSchema
symbols.expectation: Modified: composes quiz_grade_quota into the lazy ensure chain beside the six auth tables.

symbols.name: consumeQuizGradeQuota
symbols.expectation: New flag-gated consumer: resolves rank; rank 1 performs one atomic per-UTC-day upsert and throws 429 past five; learner and above and flag-off return without writing.

symbols.name: POST
symbols.expectation: Modified: stacks consumeQuizGradeQuota after the quiz.grade guard and before resolveModelFromRequest inside the nested Response-rethrow catch, passing session.userId.

deficiencies: Flag bake persists in the quota consumer on the live wire. lib/auth/quiz-quota.ts:33 kill-switch still reads process.env.MINIMAL_MODE directly and was NOT migrated in fix 33fc7232 (which converted only lib/config/feature-flags.ts and lib/auth/permissions-server.ts to globalThis.process). The compiled dev bundle chunk root-of-the-server__341fc9c2 shows consumeQuizGradeQuota compiled to an unconditional return: if (TURBOPACK compile-time truthy, 1) return; TURBOPACK unreachable, with the whole body dead-code-eliminated. Live wire proof on flag-ON dev server (MINIMAL_MODE=true): verified guest chain (signup 200, JWT verify 200, signin 200, session cookie) then 6x POST /api/quiz-grade, grades 1-5 = 200, grade 6 = 200 NOT 429 quota_exhausted; quiz_grade_quota holds ZERO rows after six grades (expected 5). The QUOTA_OK, QUOTA_PG_OK, QUOTA_RACE_OK, LIVE_OK gates all pass because vitest reads process.env at runtime and cannot see the Turbopack bake; the postcondition rank-1 performs one atomic per-UTC-day upsert and throws 429 past five is unmet on the wire. Fix: route the consumer kill-switch through the same dynamic read (isMinimalModeEnabled via globalThis.process) used by the wrapper.

slices.expectation: ensureAuthSchema composes quiz_grade_quota into the chain. consumeQuizGradeQuota allows five grades per UTC day for rank 1 and throws 429 with quota_exhausted past the cap. Learners and above never write. The quiz-grade route stacks quota after the guard.
